tasks.subject: Task 2: Discovery - one-pass warm-up + probe
tasks.description:
**Goal:** discover() walks nodes in topo order with real values: probes Dispatcher.compile(typeof(inputs)), demotes on numba compile errors or untypeable inputs (recording reasons), evaluates every node (compiled dispatcher / py_func / exotic shim), propagates runtime errors.

**Files:**
- Modify: numbox/core/variable/_kernel_partition.py
- Test: test/core/test_compile_kernel.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- json-using formula demoted with TypingError: reason; value computed via Python
- Object-returning formula demoted; consumers demoted with 'is not numba-typeable' reasons
- ZeroDivisionError propagates (no demotion); jittable values via compiled dispatcher
- cres CompileResultWAP formula evaluated via @njit shim, not demoted

**Verify:** clean caches, venv pytest test/core/test_compile_kernel.py -k discover -v -> 4 pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["numbox/core/variable/_kernel_partition.py", "test/core/test_compile_kernel.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv pytest -k discover -v per plan conventions", "acceptanceCriteria": ["unjittable demoted with reason", "object chain demotes consumers", "runtime errors propagate", "exotic shim works"], "model": "opus"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Segmented path - discovery integration, segment compile, master, plan replacement
tasks.description:
**Goal:** _discover_and_run is real: discovery -> linearize -> runs -> liveness -> per-run segment codegen + _compile + eager dispatcher.compile -> _Plan + segmented PartitionReport; warm-up call returns correct outputs; later calls run the plan; segment compile error on new types replaces the plan.

**Files:**
- Modify: numbox/core/variable/compile_kernel.py (CompiledKernel._discover_and_run)
- Test: test/core/test_compile_kernel.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Goykhman example n1-n5 (n3 json) -> partition exactly jit(n1,n2)/python(n3)/jit(n4,n5); calls 1 and 2 equal CompiledGraph result
- Object chain (_Opaque with __mul__/__add__): consecutive demoted nodes in ONE python segment; correct on calls 1+2
- All-demoted graph: zero jit segments, correct results
- Plan replacement: float sig learns 2-segment plan; _Opaque external breaks segment -> re-discovery replaces plan (all-python); old float sig still correct after
- ck.execute works in segmented mode

**Verify:** clean caches, venv pytest test/core/test_compile_kernel.py -k "segmented or goykhman or plan_replacement" -v -> 4 pass, then full file all green

tasks.subject: Task 5: Per-segment caching across processes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove segments are content-addressed cached: fresh subprocess re-discovers and its segment compiles hit numba's on-disk cache; identical jit runs share a digest harmlessly.

**Files:**
- Test: test/core/test_compile_kernel.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Subprocess A (own NUMBA_CACHE_DIR, cache=True) -> segmented mode, correct outputs, .nbc entries created
- Subprocess B (same cache dir) passes with .nbc count unchanged (pure cache hits)
- Identical-segment graph compiles and runs correctly twice

**Verify:** clean caches, venv pytest test/core/test_compile_kernel.py -k "segment_cache or shared_digest" -v -> 2 pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/core/test_compile_kernel.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv pytest -k 'segment_cache or shared_digest' -v per plan conventions", "acceptanceCriteria": ["subprocess roundtrip: nbc created then stable", "identical segments harmless"], "model": "opus"}
```
